quadrants.LL: lexically similar, semantically far (the trap / morphological negatives)
quadrants.BB: close on both axes (related family terms)

_meta.note: Descriptions are written to define the concept without restating the head phrase where possible, so that sem_desc can de-confound surface form. Curated pairs cover SS/LL/BB; DD is generated programmatically in build_probe.py.

reward_hacking.name: Reward Hacking
reward_hacking.desc: An agent exploits flaws or loopholes in its objective signal to score highly without achieving the intended outcome.

specification_gaming.name: Specification Gaming
specification_gaming.desc: A system satisfies the literal letter of a goal while violating its intended spirit, by finding unforeseen shortcuts.

goal_misgeneralization.name: Goal Misgeneralization
goal_misgeneralization.desc: A capable agent pursues an unintended objective at deployment because the training data underdetermined the true goal.

mesa_optimization.name: Mesa-Optimization
mesa_optimization.desc: A learned model internally develops its own search-and-objective process that may diverge from the outer training objective.

deceptive_alignment.name: Deceptive Alignment
deceptive_alignment.desc: A model behaves cooperatively during oversight while concealing a different objective it intends to pursue when unobserved.

sycophancy.name: Sycophancy
sycophancy.desc: A model tailors answers to match the user's apparent beliefs or desires rather than reporting what is accurate.

reward_overoptimization.name: Reward Model Overoptimization
reward_overoptimization.desc: Pushing a policy too hard against a learned proxy of human preference degrades true quality once the proxy diverges.

scalable_oversight.name: Scalable Oversight
scalable_oversight.desc: Techniques that let humans supervise systems on tasks too hard or too numerous for direct human checking.

constitutional_ai.name: Constitutional AI
constitutional_ai.desc: Training a model to critique and revise its own outputs against a written set of principles instead of per-example human labels.

rlhf.name: RLHF
rlhf.desc: Aligning a model by fitting a preference model to human comparisons and optimizing the policy against it.

jailbreak.name: Jailbreak
jailbreak.desc: An input crafted to bypass a model's safety constraints and elicit disallowed behavior.

prompt_injection.name: Prompt Injection
prompt_injection.desc: Untrusted content smuggles instructions into a model's context to override the operator's intended directives.

corrigibility.name: Corrigibility
corrigibility.desc: The property that an agent permits and assists human correction or shutdown rather than resisting it.

instrumental_convergence.name: Instrumental Convergence
instrumental_convergence.desc: Diverse final goals tend to induce similar sub-goals such as resource acquisition and self-preservation.

power_seeking.name: Power Seeking
power_seeking.desc: An agent's tendency to acquire control over resources and options because doing so helps most objectives.

chain_of_thought.name: Chain of Thought
chain_of_thought.desc: Eliciting intermediate written steps before a final answer to improve multi-step problem solving.

tree_of_thoughts.name: Tree of Thoughts
tree_of_thoughts.desc: Exploring and evaluating multiple branching intermediate solution paths with backtracking before committing.

self_consistency.name: Self-Consistency
self_consistency.desc: Sampling several independent solution attempts and selecting the answer that recurs most often.

process_reward_models.name: Process Reward Models
process_reward_models.desc: Scoring each intermediate step of a solution so feedback targets where the reasoning goes wrong.

outcome_reward_models.name: Outcome Reward Models
outcome_reward_models.desc: Scoring only the final result of an attempt, ignoring how the intermediate steps were produced.

scratchpad.name: Scratchpad
scratchpad.desc: Letting a model write working notes in a scratch region to offload intermediate computation before answering.

react_prompting.name: ReAct
react_prompting.desc: Interleaving reasoning traces with tool actions and observations so the model can plan and gather evidence.

least_to_most.name: Least-to-Most Prompting
least_to_most.desc: Decomposing a hard problem into easier subproblems solved in sequence, each using prior answers.

self_refine.name: Self-Refine
self_refine.desc: A model iteratively critiques and rewrites its own draft to improve quality without external feedback.

verifier_models.name: Verifier Models
verifier_models.desc: A separate judge trained to assess candidate solutions and pick or rank the correct one.

speculative_decoding.name: Speculative Decoding
speculative_decoding.desc: Accelerating generation by drafting tokens with a small model and verifying them in parallel with a large one.

best_of_n.name: Best-of-N Sampling
best_of_n.desc: Generating many candidate answers and returning the one a scorer rates highest.

majority_voting.name: Majority Voting
majority_voting.desc: Aggregating several independent predictions by choosing the most frequently produced output.

causal_inference.name: Causal Inference
causal_inference.desc: Estimating the effect of interventions from data by separating genuine influence from mere association.

causal_decision_theory.name: Causal Decision Theory
causal_decision_theory.desc: A normative rule for choosing actions by the outcomes they physically bring about, not by what they merely indicate.

functional_decision_theory.name: Functional Decision Theory
functional_decision_theory.desc: A normative rule that chooses as if selecting the output of a decision procedure shared across identical situations.

evidential_decision_theory.name: Evidential Decision Theory
evidential_decision_theory.desc: A normative rule that ranks actions by the desirability of the news that taking them would convey.

propensity_score.name: Propensity Score
propensity_score.desc: The estimated probability of receiving a treatment given covariates, used to balance groups before comparison.

instrumental_variable.name: Instrumental Variable
instrumental_variable.desc: A variable that shifts exposure but affects the outcome only through it, enabling effect estimation despite confounders.

do_calculus.name: Do-Calculus
do_calculus.desc: A set of graph rules for deciding when an interventional quantity can be computed from observational data.

confounding.name: Confounding
confounding.desc: A common cause of both exposure and outcome that biases naive estimates of their relationship.

counterfactual.name: Counterfactual
counterfactual.desc: A statement about what an outcome would have been under a different, unrealized condition.

average_treatment_effect.name: Average Treatment Effect
average_treatment_effect.desc: The mean difference in outcome a population would show if all were treated versus all untreated.

regression_discontinuity.name: Regression Discontinuity
regression_discontinuity.desc: Identifying an effect by comparing units just above and below a cutoff that assigns treatment.

linear_probing.name: Linear Probing
linear_probing.desc: Freezing a network and training a simple readout on its features to test what information they encode.

linear_regression.name: Linear Regression
linear_regression.desc: Fitting a straight-line relationship between predictors and a continuous target by least squares.

gradient_clipping.name: Gradient Clipping
gradient_clipping.desc: Capping the magnitude of update signals to keep training stable when they occasionally explode.

gradient_checkpointing.name: Gradient Checkpointing
gradient_checkpointing.desc: Trading compute for memory by recomputing intermediate activations during backpropagation instead of storing them.

weight_decay.name: Weight Decay
weight_decay.desc: Shrinking parameters toward zero each update to discourage overly complex fits.

lr_warmup.name: Learning Rate Warmup
lr_warmup.desc: Starting optimization with small step sizes that ramp up, to avoid early instability.

batch_norm.name: Batch Normalization
batch_norm.desc: Rescaling layer inputs using statistics across a minibatch to stabilize and speed up training.

layer_norm.name: Layer Normalization
layer_norm.desc: Rescaling a layer's activations using statistics across its features for each example independently.

dropout.name: Dropout
dropout.desc: Randomly disabling units during training so the network cannot rely on any single feature.

mixture_of_experts.name: Mixture of Experts
mixture_of_experts.desc: Routing each input to a few specialized subnetworks so capacity grows without proportional compute.

lora.name: LoRA
lora.desc: Adapting a large model cheaply by training small low-rank update matrices while freezing the original weights.

quantization.name: Quantization
quantization.desc: Representing weights or activations with fewer bits to cut memory and speed up inference.

dense_retrieval.name: Dense Retrieval
dense_retrieval.desc: Finding relevant items by comparing learned continuous vectors of queries and documents.

sparse_retrieval.name: Sparse Retrieval
sparse_retrieval.desc: Finding relevant items by matching weighted term-overlap signals over a high-dimensional lexical space.

cross_encoder.name: Cross-Encoder
cross_encoder.desc: Scoring a query and candidate jointly in one pass for high accuracy at high cost per pair.

bi_encoder.name: Bi-Encoder
bi_encoder.desc: Encoding query and candidate separately into vectors so matches can be precomputed and searched fast.

bm25.name: BM25
bm25.desc: A ranking function that scores documents by term frequency and rarity with length normalization.

reranking.name: Reranking
reranking.desc: Reordering an initial candidate shortlist with a more expensive, more accurate scorer.

contrastive_learning.name: Contrastive Learning
contrastive_learning.desc: Training representations by pulling matched pairs together and pushing mismatched pairs apart.

hard_negative_mining.name: Hard Negative Mining
hard_negative_mining.desc: Selecting deceptively similar non-matches as training examples to sharpen a model's discrimination.

ann_search.name: Approximate Nearest Neighbor
ann_search.desc: Trading a little accuracy for speed when searching large vector collections for close points.

inverted_index.name: Inverted Index
inverted_index.desc: A data structure mapping each term to the list of documents containing it for fast lookup.

morphological_subcluster.note: Negative control: a category guessable by the shared head phrase 'Decision Theory'. Members are a genuine family but the link to the tag is carried by surface form. Used in the scale-test to check the rule does not let a form-defined cluster pass as semantic.
